data.long_meaning: Dhruva is the name of a famous celestial being in Hindu mythology. He is the embodiment of unwavering determination and dedication. Dhruva, the son of King Uttanpada, was known for his unwavering devotion to Lord Vishnu. He was given a boon by Lord Vishnu that he would attain the position of the North Star, Polaris. Dhruva's unwavering spirit and devotion are symbolized in the name Dhruvin.

historical_references.reference: Dhruv was a legendary king and the son of king Uttanpada of the Ikshvaku dynasty. He is also known as Dhruva, Dhruva-dhanvantari and Dhruva-Raja. Once, Dhruv had a vision of the Vasudeva, an avatar of Lord Vishnu, and asked for a boon to regain his lost kingdom. The boon granted to him was that the pole star would be stationary over the spot where he sat in penance. This star came to be known as Dhruva or Polaris.

The name Dhruv occurs in several literary works of ancient India. In the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, the character Dhruvadhara is mentioned, who was a charioteer of Arjuna in the great battle of Kurukshetra. Dhruvadhara was a descendant of the lunar dynasty and was known for his unwavering devotion to Lord Arjuna and his guru Krishna.

On Instagram, Dhruvin Patel, an Indian influencer with a large following, showcases his fashionable and trendy outfits, collaborating with luxury brands and inspiring millions.
